class.name: GameplayComponent
class.brief_description: A reusable gameplay capability with an explicit owner and activation state.
class.description: GameplayComponent adds gameplay ownership and activation semantics without changing the scene-tree ownership model. The gameplay owner is independent from [member Node.owner] and multiplayer authority.

method.name: activate
method.description: Activates the component and emits [signal activated]. Calling this while active has no effect.

method.name: deactivate
method.description: Deactivates the component and emits [signal deactivated]. Calling this while inactive has no effect.

method.name: get_gameplay_owner
method.description: Returns the explicit gameplay owner, or [code]null[/code] if it is unset or no longer exists.

method.name: set_gameplay_owner
method.description: Sets the explicit gameplay owner and emits [signal gameplay_owner_changed].

members.member: A stable name used to identify this capability.

signal.name: activated
signal.description: Emitted after the component becomes active.

signal.name: deactivated
signal.description: Emitted after the component becomes inactive.

signal.name: gameplay_owner_changed
signal.description: Emitted when the explicit gameplay owner changes.
